Welcome to Dumaguete Animal Sanctuary (DAS), a nonprofit no-kill animal shelter in the Philippines.

We rescue, rehabilitate, and care for animals in vulnerable situations while working toward long-term solutions to animal welfare. Alongside caring for hundreds of rescued animals, we run an ongoing sterilisation, vaccination, and microchipping programme for both owned and stray dogs and cats, helping reduce suffering at its source.

Alongside our community programmes, we care for hundreds of rescued animals and are building a new 2.8-hectare sanctuary that will provide veterinary services, rehabilitation facilities, and lifelong care for animals with nowhere else to go.
